content.text: review and create a new release then push
I’ll review the current changes and release workflow, run the required checks, then create and push the release.

The release includes the unpushed Qwik 2 migration and the current Devenv hook changes. I’m reviewing both and targeting v0.19.1. I’m also using the Vet skill for an additional review and checking that the new commit hook permits version bumps.

I found a release blocker: the new pre-commit hook requires the version tag before Bun can create the version commit. An isolated rehearsal confirmed the failure. I’ll keep that check on pre-push and in the version lifecycle scripts.

The application tests passed: 1,291 passed, 39 skipped. Production build and lint also passed.
